question: If the areas of two similar triangles are in the ratio 196 : 625, what would be the ratio of the corresponding sides?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two similar triangles, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of sides = √(Ratio of Areas)

Ratio of sides = √196 : √625

Ratio of sides = 14 : 25

**∴ The correct answer is 14 : 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of areas of two similar triangles = 196 : 625

**Formula used:**

If ΔABC ∼ ΔPQR, then Area(ΔABC) ÷ Area(ΔPQR) = (AB ÷ PQ)² = (BC ÷ QR)² = (AC ÷ PR)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/122ca963ce2ebdcfaf24681cde46406bc882f427a2b47ec56a6c3f37dd106060.png] 

Let the corresponding sides of the two triangles be s₁ and s₂.

Let the areas of the two triangles be A₁ and A₂.

⇒ A₁ ÷ A₂ = (s₁ ÷ s₂)²

⇒ 196 ÷ 625 = (s₁ ÷ s₂)²

⇒ s₁ ÷ s₂ = √(196 ÷ 625)

⇒ s₁ ÷ s₂ = 14 ÷ 25

⇒ s₁ : s₂ = 14 : 25

**∴ The correct answer is 14 : 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides: P₁/P₂ = s₁/s₂.

Ratio of Altitudes and Medians

The ratio of corresponding altitudes, medians, or angle bisectors of two similar triangles is also equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Area Theorem

The theorem states that for two similar triangles, the ratio of their areas is the square of the ratio of any two corresponding linear dimensions.</p
